# Market Claim Verifier

> Paste a finance post. Every number is checked against SEC filings, and you get a corrected draft with citations.

The model proposes; the program decides. Muse Spark chooses SEC tools; Python binds evidence, checks periods/units/numeric tolerances and decides supported, contradicted or insufficient evidence. Cited corrected drafts use program values, not a model rewrite.

## Judge path and idea

- [For judges — 3-minute path](README.md#for-judges--3-minute-path): video publication pending, live check, saved replay, benchmark audit. Judges: password in the submission notes; saved examples need none.
- [Judge guide](JUDGES.md) and [the idea](README.md#the-idea): DappGo's internal checks found right numbers paired with wrong periods, units or comparisons. Architecture and a six-step walkthrough explain model/program responsibilities.

## What it does and how to use it

- [Inputs, coverage, outputs and providers](README.md#what-it-does): US-GAAP SEC filers, ≈8,000 companies; 23 tested. SEC XBRL generally 2009 onward through the latest filing. [Scope report](docs/evidence/REVIEW_GUIDE.md#facts-in-detail).
- [Site and CLI](README.md#how-to-use): website text ≤600 characters; 3 stories × 5 packaged inputs, provider choice, compare, public history and edit/re-run. [Site report](docs/evidence/try-v3-site-2026-11-03/REPORT.md). Arbitrary uploads remain planned. CLI also reads images, native-text PDF, audio and video. Media uses Meta OCR/ASR before the selected text verifier.
- [Live check](https://hackathon.dappgo.com/#live-check) · [Saved check](https://hackathon.dappgo.com/#recorded-run). Saved examples retain historical cost, duration and traces; they are not fresh execution.
- [Provider boundaries](docs/PROVIDERS.md) · [Evidence-record contract](docs/EVIDENCE_RECORDS.md) · [CLI technical reference](docs/evidence/TECHNICAL_GUIDE.md).

## Cost and speed

[README table](README.md#cost--speed): rounded live headline $0.01 / 6 s from the [production receipt](docs/evidence/live-prod-2026-11-03/REPORT.md); $0.02 per benchmark claim, 10 s median, p95 21 s from the [original report](docs/evidence/eval-v2-2026-10-27/REPORT.md#metrics). The live $0.01–0.04 / 6–25 s band is planning guidance by input size, not an observed minimum/maximum or an SLA; longer saved posts can exceed it. Media preprocessing is additional and itemized. [Cost provenance and limits](docs/evidence/readme-v3-2026-11-04/REPORT.md#cost-and-speed).

## Accuracy and evidence

- [Original held-out text benchmark](docs/evidence/eval-v2-2026-10-27/REPORT.md#metrics): **90.2% (240/266)**, **false support 1/139** reference contradicted/insufficient claims, Baseten Muse Spark Open. Failures count as wrong. Two gold answers were corrected; [registered-gold scores](docs/evidence/eval-v2-2026-10-27/REPORT-registered-gold.md) remain. The manifest records a dirty working tree.
- [Provider/method table](README.md#original-benchmark): historical all-claim results are separate from held-out results. [Later agent rerun](docs/evidence/eval-v2-2026-10-28-r2-posthoc/REPORT.md) is post-hoc; empty single-shot rows are not results.
- [78 Threads / 80 news](docs/evidence/real-world-2026-11-02/REPORT.md): real-world coverage, failures and costs; coverage ≠ accuracy. Frozen-text [fixchecks](docs/evidence/real-world-2026-11-03-fixcheck/REPORT.md) do not retest OCR/ASR.
- [Evidence index](docs/evidence/INDEX.md) · [Per-claim explorer](https://hackathon.dappgo.com/explorer/) · [Real-world explorer](https://hackathon.dappgo.com/wild/) · [Media reports and limits](README.md#real-world-and-media-evidence).

## Limits, verification and records

[Limits & honesty](README.md#limits--honesty): extraction can miss assertions; ambiguous periods, restatements, non-GAAP definitions and sampled frames limit checks. A corrected draft never approves an article. Live limits are $10/day, $60 lifetime, 5 checks / 10 min per IP; authenticated inputs/results are public for 14 days. [Configuration report](docs/evidence/readme-v3-2026-11-04/REPORT.md#scope-and-limits).

[Offline verification](README.md#verify-offline): `bash scripts/verify.sh`; use `UV_OFFLINE=1` after locked dependencies are cached. No model calls or SEC fetches during verification. [Test-record retention](docs/TEST_RECORDS.md) includes failed/partial attempts. [Language policy](docs/LANGUAGE.md) separates English and Traditional Chinese reading layers while retaining original records.
